_comment: Hand-made placement of stories nothing we dump triggers. Key = exact story id, or a prefix ending with '*'. Value = {"area": "<area name as in the codex>"} or {"event": "<event display name>"}, optional "note". Applied by build_codex after the automatic rule (story id prefix == area id). Review candidates in md/misc/unassigned.md or the viewer's 'Unassigned' group. Nothing is guessed here — entries are added only when the placement is known.
